livecrime.audit.ignored_test: Admin test contract {label} ({key}) at {place}: test contracts are never live crimes
livecrime.audit.ignored_type: {label} ({key}) at {place}: its police alert went out, but Config.LiveCrime.types turns this crime off
livecrime.audit.ignored_none: {label} ({key}) at {place}, {street}: its police alert went out, but none of the {crew} crew members can be a suspect ({why}), so there is no LIVE call
livecrime.audit.reported: {label} ({key}) at {place}, {street}: {suspects} of {crew} crew members are suspects, mission type {type}{left}
livecrime.why.excluded: excluded (server.cfg ace or an admin's Exclude)
err.setting_live_type: A crime names an unknown mission type. Use a mission type in Config.MissionTypes (such as investigation or tactical), or false.
livecrime.audit.not_posted: {label} ({key}) at {place}, {street}: it has suspects, but no LIVE call was posted ({why})
livecrime.why.max_live: too many LIVE calls and live cases at once (Config.LiveCrime.maxLiveRuns)
block.live_response.end_confirm: End this live case now? Your unit keeps what it has earned so far.
bonus.live_scene: Secured the scene of a live crime
result.lines_only: Live case: the lines below are the points (no base points)
livecrime.mission.label: Live case
livecrime.mission.description: A real crime reported to the police: respond, secure the scene, then detain and book the suspects.
err.live_case_off: Live crimes are switched off on this server.
err.live_case_gone: This crime is over, or its suspects are already in another case. Pick another call.
err.live_case_suspect_used: These suspects already gave the police all their points for today. Pick another call.
err.live_case_own_suspect: You, or someone in your unit, can't take a case against your own character or account. Leave this one to another unit.
err.live_case_suspended: You, or someone in your unit, is suspended from live cases by an admin. Ask an admin for details.
err.live_case_recent_suspect: You, or someone in your unit, was a suspect too recently to take a live case. Try again later.
err.live_case_pair_blocked: An admin has blocked you, or someone in your unit, from cases against one of these suspects. Leave this one to another unit.
err.live_case_pair_cooldown: You, or someone in your unit, had a case against one of these suspects too recently. Leave this one to another unit.
livecrime.join.title: Join the live case?
livecrime.join.content: Officers are working a live case nearby: {title} on {street}. Join them? Points only for what happens after you join; your next real call still comes first.
livecrime.join.expired: The offer to join that live case has run out.
err.live_join_off: Backup for live cases is switched off on this server.
err.live_join_full: This live case already has as many officers as it may have. Pick another call.
err.live_join_already: You are already on this live case, so there is nothing to join.
err.live_join_left: You left this live case and can't join it again. Pick another call.
err.live_join_not_live: This case has not started, or is not a live case. Only a live case takes officers after it has started.
unit.ready.toast_live: {leader} claimed a LIVE call for your unit: {title}, {street}. Suspects: {n} (real players). Answer on the Unit screen within {seconds} s.
run.live.title: Live case
run.live.reported_free_none: Last reported {ago} ago: no suspect was free and online
run.live.reported_wait: Last-reported points start once an officer reaches the scene
run.live.reported_off: Last-reported points are off on this server
run.live.fair: The suspects are real players. The map shows where each free suspect was last reported, never a live position, and the steps never change for one suspect.
run.live.end_hint: You lead this case: End case is in your radial menu.
result.live.title: Live case: the suspects
result.live.open: The case was still running when you left.
livecrime.surrender.ask_content_self: Give yourself up to the officers on your case? Stay where you are and keep your hands empty until they cuff you.
livecrime.surrender.ask_title_talk: An officer is talking you down
livecrime.surrender.ask_content_talk: An officer asks you to give yourself up. Surrender? If you say yes, stay where you are and keep your hands empty until they cuff you. You can say no.
livecrime.surrender.not_wanted: You are not wanted in a live case
livecrime.surrender.pending: A surrender question is already open
livecrime.surrender.expired: Too late: the question ran out
livecrime.surrender.no_officer: No officer of the case is close enough to surrender to
livecrime.surrender.done: You surrendered: stay where you are and keep your hands empty until the officers cuff you
livecrime.surrender.ended_released: Your surrender is over: you got out of the cuffs
livecrime.surrender.ended_armed: Your surrender is over: you drew a weapon
livecrime.surrender.ended_moved: Your surrender is over: you moved away
livecrime.surrender.ended_lapsed: Your surrender ran out: nobody cuffed you in time
livecrime.talk.no_case: You are not on a live case
livecrime.talk.none: No suspect is close enough to talk down
livecrime.talk.busy: That suspect is already being asked
livecrime.talk.cooldown: Give them a moment before you ask again
livecrime.talk.hint: Suspect {label} is close enough to talk down: use Talk them down in your radial menu
